# unsupported-claim-flagger

> Flag answer sentences whose numbers, dates, quotes or proper names do not appear in the supplied context, without needing citations or an LLM Python package `trysac-unsupported-claim-flagger`, import name `unsupported_claim_flagger`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
